notes.title: Chernobyl Trap Will Be Removed From Steam Store
notes.content: [p]Dear Players,[/p][p]We regret to inform you that the game Chernobyl Trap will be officially removed from sale since December 15. This decision comes as part of our ongoing efforts to focus on a new project. We are working on a new game that will have better quality than this one. All purchased copies will remain in Steam library and will still be available for download and play.[/p][p]We want to thank our dedicated community for your support and passion for Chernobyl Trap. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we hope to see you in our future project.[/p][p]Stay tuned for news![/p]
